description: This file defines types and a function for rendering Markdown IR (intermediate representation) into a string with styling and links, including style ordering, sorting spans, and handling of links and styles during rendering.

methods.name: sortStyleSpans
methods.description: Sorts style spans based on start position, end position, and style rank.

methods.name: renderMarkdownWithMarkers
methods.description: Renders Markdown IR into a string with style markers and links, handling overlapping spans and link building.
